integrity: All proofs and reproducible computations are provided; finite numerical tests are supplementary, and no independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns positive quadratic-Gaussian radial windows only. A general Hermite ambiguity identity can imply the explicit polynomial, but sharp real-zero geometry, dimensional topology change and active-frequency thresholds were not identified in inspected predecessors; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Sharp Doppler null thresholds and a dimension-induced topology change for positive radial Gaussian polynomials
